transactions.desc: The Mets acquired Amick and Bruin Agbayani from the Twins on Thursday in exchange for A.J. Minter, Will Sammon of The Athletic reports.
The New York Mets traded LHP A.J. Minter to the Minnesota Twins.
The Minnesota Twins traded INF Billy Amick to the New York Mets.
The Minnesota Twins traded INF Bruin Agbayani to the New York Mets.
The Twins acquired Minter from the Mets on Thursday in exchange for Bruin Agbayani and Billy Amick, Jeff Passan of ESPN.com reports.
The Baltimore Orioles traded RHP Zane Barnhart to the Detroit Tigers.
The Detroit Tigers traded C Jake Rogers to the Baltimore Orioles.
The Athletics claimed Thomas off waivers from Atlanta on Thursday.
The Reds optioned Petty to Triple-A Louisville on Thursday.
The Reds optioned Arroyo to Triple-A Louisville on Thursday.
The Reds recalled McCambley from Triple-A Louisville on Thursday.
The Reds activated McLain (calf) from the 10-day injured list Thursday.
The Nationals activated Irvin (shoulder) from the 60-day injured list Thursday.
The Rangers recalled Santos from Triple-A Round Rock on Thursday.
The Texas Rangers traded INF Angel Arredondo to the Los Angeles Angels.
The Rangers acquired Silseth and catcher Logan O'Hoppe from the Angels on Wednesday in exchange for infielder Angel Arredondo, Jeff Passan of ESPN.com reports.
The Los Angeles Angels traded RHP Chase Silseth to the Texas Rangers.
The Los Angeles Angels traded C Logan O'Hoppe to the Texas Rangers.
Atlanta optioned Smith-Shawver to Triple-A Gwinnett after Wednesday's game against the Mets.
The Angels reinstated d'Arnaud (foot) from the injured list Wednesday.
The Dodgers designated Barnes for assignment Wednesday.
The Dodgers activated Diaz (elbow) from the 60-day injured list Wednesday.
The Red Sox recalled Sogard from Triple-A Worcester on Wednesday.
The Twins recalled Gray from Triple-A St. Paul on Wednesday.
The Cubs selected Woodford's contract from Triple-A Iowa on Wednesday.
The Cubs designated Wantz for assignment on Wednesday.
The Astros reinstated Wesneski (elbow) from the injured list ahead of his start Wednesday against the Angels.
The Astros optioned Ullola to Triple-A Sugar Land on Wednesday.
Krook elected to enter free agency Wednesday after declining his outright assignment from the Nationals to Triple-A Rochester.
The Nationals optioned Schultz to Triple-A Rochester on Wednesday.
